timeline: You assume numbers always win until you look at what Major Shaitan Singh did on November eighteenth.
About 120 men faced three thousand troops.
Without artillery support to help them.
The freezing wind howled across Rezang La.
Wave after wave attacked their icy bunkers.
They fought on until their last round.
Every single man held his ground.
A legend forged in sub-zero cold.
You assume numbers always win until you look at what Major Shaitan Singh did on November eighteenth.
